paragraphs.text: Now before the feast of the passover, Jesus knowing that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto his Father, having loved his own that were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
paragraphs.original: Πρὸ δὲ τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ πάσχα εἰδὼς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἦλθεν αὐτοῦ ἡ ὥρα ἵνα μεταβῇ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου πρὸς τὸν πατέρα ἀγαπήσας τοὺς ἰδίους τοὺς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰς τέλος ἠγάπησεν αὐτούς.
paragraphs.translit: Pro de tēs heortēs tou pascha eidōs ho Iēsous hoti ēlthen autou hē hōra hina metabē ek tou kosmou toutou pros ton patera agapēsas tous idious tous en tō kosmō eis telos ēgapēsen autous.

paragraphs.text: And during supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon`s [son], to betray him,
paragraphs.original: καὶ δείπνου γινομένου, τοῦ διαβόλου ἤδη βεβληκότος εἰς τὴν καρδίαν ἵνα παραδοῖ αὐτὸν Ἰούδας Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου,
paragraphs.translit: kai deipnou ginomenou, tou diabolou ēdē beblēkotos eis tēn kardian hina paradoi auton Ioudas Simōnos Iskariōtou,

paragraphs.text: [Jesus], knowing that the Father had given all the things into his hands, and that he came forth from God, and goeth unto God,
paragraphs.original: εἰδὼς ὅτι πάντα ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ πατὴρ εἰς τὰς χεῖρας, καὶ ὅτι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθεν καὶ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ὑπάγει,
paragraphs.translit: eidōs hoti panta edōken autō ho patēr eis tas cheiras, kai hoti apo theou exēlthen kai pros ton theon hypagei,

paragraphs.text: riseth from supper, and layeth aside his garments; and he took a towel, and girded himself.
paragraphs.original: ἐγείρεται ἐκ τοῦ δείπνου καὶ τίθησιν τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ λαβὼν λέντιον διέζωσεν ἑαυτόν·
paragraphs.translit: egeiretai ek tou deipnou kai tithēsin ta himatia kai labōn lention diezōsen heauton·

paragraphs.text: Then he poureth water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples` feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
paragraphs.original: εἶτα βάλλει ὕδωρ εἰς τὸν νιπτῆρα, καὶ ἤρξατο νίπτειν τοὺς πόδας τῶν μαθητῶν καὶ ἐκμάσσειν τῷ λεντίῳ ᾧ ἦν διεζωσμένος.
paragraphs.translit: eita ballei hydōr eis ton niptēra, kai ērxato niptein tous podas tōn mathētōn kai ekmassein tō lentiō hō ēn diezōsmenos.

paragraphs.text: So he cometh to Simon Peter. He saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
paragraphs.original: ἔρχεται οὖν πρὸς Σίμωνα Πέτρον. λέγει αὐτῷ· Κύριε, σύ μου νίπτεις τοὺς πόδας;
paragraphs.translit: erchetai oun pros Simōna Petron. legei autō· Kyrie, sy mou nipteis tous podas;

paragraphs.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt understand hereafter.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ὃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ σὺ οὐκ οἶδας ἄρτι, γνώσῃ δὲ μετὰ ταῦτα.
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autō· Ho egō poiō sy ouk oidas arti, gnōsē de meta tauta.

paragraphs.text: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
paragraphs.original: λέγει αὐτῷ Πέτρος· Οὐ μὴ νίψῃς μου τοὺς πόδας εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς αὐτῷ· Ἐὰν μὴ νίψω σε, οὐκ ἔχεις μέρος μετʼ ἐμοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: legei autō Petros· Ou mē nipsēs mou tous podas eis ton aiōna. apekrithē Iēsous autō· Ean mē nipsō se, ouk echeis meros metʼ emou.

paragraphs.text: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
paragraphs.original: λέγει αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος· Κύριε, μὴ τοὺς πόδας μου μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τὴν κεφαλήν.
paragraphs.translit: legei autō Simōn Petros· Kyrie, mē tous podas mou monon alla kai tas cheiras kai tēn kephalēn.

paragraphs.text: Jesus saith to him, He that is bathed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
paragraphs.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὁ λελουμένος οὐκ ἔχει χρείαν εἰ μὴ τοὺς πόδας νίψασθαι, ἀλλʼ ἔστιν καθαρὸς ὅλος· καὶ ὑμεῖς καθαροί ἐστε, ἀλλʼ οὐχὶ πάντες.
paragraphs.translit: legei autō ho Iēsous· Ho leloumenos ouk echei chreian ei mē tous podas nipsasthai, allʼ estin katharos holos· kai hymeis katharoi este, allʼ ouchi pantes.

paragraphs.text: For he knew him that should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
paragraphs.original: ᾔδει γὰρ τὸν παραδιδόντα αὐτόν· διὰ τοῦτο εἶπεν ὅτι Οὐχὶ πάντες καθαροί ἐστε.
paragraphs.translit: ēdei gar ton paradidonta auton· dia touto eipen hoti Ouchi pantes katharoi este.

paragraphs.text: So when he had washed their feet, and taken his garments, and sat down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
paragraphs.original: Ὅτε οὖν ἔνιψεν τοὺς πόδας αὐτῶν καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνέπεσεν, πάλιν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Γινώσκετε τί πεποίηκα ὑμῖν;
paragraphs.translit: Hote oun enipsen tous podas autōn kai elaben ta himatia autou kai anepesen, palin eipen autois· Ginōskete ti pepoiēka hymin;

paragraphs.text: Ye call me, Teacher, and, Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς φωνεῖτέ με Ὁ διδάσκαλος καὶ Ὁ κύριος, καὶ καλῶς λέγετε, εἰμὶ γάρ.
paragraphs.translit: hymeis phōneite me Ho didaskalos kai Ho kyrios, kai kalōs legete, eimi gar.

paragraphs.text: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, ye also ought to wash one another`s feet.
paragraphs.original: εἰ οὖν ἐγὼ ἔνιψα ὑμῶν τοὺς πόδας ὁ κύριος καὶ ὁ διδάσκαλος, καὶ ὑμεῖς ὀφείλετε ἀλλήλων νίπτειν τοὺς πόδας·
paragraphs.translit: ei oun egō enipsa hymōn tous podas ho kyrios kai ho didaskalos, kai hymeis opheilete allēlōn niptein tous podas·

paragraphs.text: For I have given you an example, that ye also should do as I have done to you.
paragraphs.original: ὑπόδειγμα γὰρ ἔδωκα ὑμῖν ἵνα καθὼς ἐγὼ ἐποίησα ὑμῖν καὶ ὑμεῖς ποιῆτε.
paragraphs.translit: hypodeigma gar edōka hymin hina kathōs egō epoiēsa hymin kai hymeis poiēte.

paragraphs.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, a servant is not greater than his lord; neither one that is sent greater than he that sent him.
paragraphs.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐκ ἔστιν δοῦλος μείζων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἀπόστολος μείζων τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: amēn amēn legō hymin, ouk estin doulos meizōn tou kyriou autou oude apostolos meizōn tou pempsantos auton.

paragraphs.text: If ye know these things, blessed are ye if ye do them.
paragraphs.original: εἰ ταῦτα οἴδατε, μακάριοί ἐστε ἐὰν ποιῆτε αὐτά.
paragraphs.translit: ei tauta oidate, makarioi este ean poiēte auta.

paragraphs.text: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled: He that eateth my bread lifted up his heel against me.
paragraphs.original: οὐ περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν λέγω· ἐγὼ οἶδα τίνας ἐξελεξάμην· ἀλλʼ ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ· Ὁ τρώγων μου τὸν ἄρτον ἐπῆρεν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ τὴν πτέρναν αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ou peri pantōn hymōn legō· egō oida tinas exelexamēn· allʼ hina hē graphē plērōthē· Ho trōgōn mou ton arton epēren epʼ eme tēn pternan autou.

paragraphs.text: From henceforth I tell you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am [he].
paragraphs.original: ἀπʼ ἄρτι λέγω ὑμῖν πρὸ τοῦ γενέσθαι, ἵνα πιστεύσητε ὅταν γένηται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι.
paragraphs.translit: apʼ arti legō hymin pro tou genesthai, hina pisteusēte hotan genētai hoti egō eimi.

paragraphs.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, he that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
paragraphs.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ λαμβάνων ἄν τινα πέμψω ἐμὲ λαμβάνει, ὁ δὲ ἐμὲ λαμβάνων λαμβάνει τὸν πέμψαντά με.
paragraphs.translit: amēn amēn legō hymin, ho lambanōn an tina pempsō eme lambanei, ho de eme lambanōn lambanei ton pempsanta me.

paragraphs.text: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in the spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
paragraphs.original: Ταῦτα εἰπὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐταράχθη τῷ πνεύματι καὶ ἐμαρτύρησεν καὶ εἶπεν· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με.
paragraphs.translit: Tauta eipōn ho Iēsous etarachthē tō pneumati kai emartyrēsen kai eipen· Amēn amēn legō hymin hoti heis ex hymōn paradōsei me.

paragraphs.text: The disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
paragraphs.original: ἔβλεπον εἰς ἀλλήλους οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀπορούμενοι περὶ τίνος λέγει.
paragraphs.translit: eblepon eis allēlous hoi mathētai aporoumenoi peri tinos legei.

paragraphs.text: There was at the table reclining in Jesus` bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
paragraphs.original: ἦν ἀνακείμενος εἷς ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς·
paragraphs.translit: ēn anakeimenos heis ek tōn mathētōn autou en tō kolpō tou Iēsou, hon ēgapa ho Iēsous·

paragraphs.text: Simon Peter therefore beckoneth to him, and saith unto him, Tell [us] who it is of whom he speaketh.
paragraphs.original: νεύει οὖν τούτῳ Σίμων Πέτρος πυθέσθαι τίς ἂν εἴη περὶ οὗ λέγει.
paragraphs.translit: neuei oun toutō Simōn Petros pythesthai tis an eiē peri hou legei.

paragraphs.text: He leaning back, as he was, on Jesus` breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
paragraphs.original: ἀναπεσὼν ἐκεῖνος οὕτως ἐπὶ τὸ στῆθος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ λέγει αὐτῷ· Κύριε, τίς ἐστιν;
paragraphs.translit: anapesōn ekeinos houtōs epi to stēthos tou Iēsou legei autō· Kyrie, tis estin;

paragraphs.text: Jesus therefore answereth, He it is, for whom I shall dip the sop, and give it him. So when he had dipped the sop, he taketh and giveth it to Judas, [the son] of Simon Iscariot.
paragraphs.original: ἀποκρίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ᾧ ἐγὼ βάψω τὸ ψωμίον καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ· βάψας οὖν τὸ ψωμίον δίδωσιν Ἰούδᾳ Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου.
paragraphs.translit: apokrinetai ho Iēsous· Ekeinos estin hō egō bapsō to psōmion kai dōsō autō· bapsas oun to psōmion didōsin Iouda Simōnos Iskariōtou.

paragraphs.text: And after the sop, then entered Satan into him. Jesus therefore saith unto him, What thou doest, do quickly.
paragraphs.original: καὶ μετὰ τὸ ψωμίον τότε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς ἐκεῖνον ὁ Σατανᾶς. λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὃ ποιεῖς ποίησον τάχιον.
paragraphs.translit: kai meta to psōmion tote eisēlthen eis ekeinon ho Satanas. legei oun autō ho Iēsous· Ho poieis poiēson tachion.

paragraphs.text: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο δὲ οὐδεὶς ἔγνω τῶν ἀνακειμένων πρὸς τί εἶπεν αὐτῷ·
paragraphs.translit: touto de oudeis egnō tōn anakeimenōn pros ti eipen autō·

paragraphs.text: For some thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus said unto him, Buy what things we have need of for the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
paragraphs.original: τινὲς γὰρ ἐδόκουν, ἐπεὶ τὸ γλωσσόκομον εἶχεν Ἰούδας, ὅτι λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀγόρασον ὧν χρείαν ἔχομεν εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, ἢ τοῖς πτωχοῖς ἵνα τι δῷ.
paragraphs.translit: tines gar edokoun, epei to glōssokomon eichen Ioudas, hoti legei autō ho Iēsous· Agorason hōn chreian echomen eis tēn heortēn, ē tois ptōchois hina ti dō.

paragraphs.text: He then having received the sop went out straightway: and it was night.
paragraphs.original: λαβὼν οὖν τὸ ψωμίον ἐκεῖνος ἐξῆλθεν εὐθύς. ἦν δὲ νύξ.
paragraphs.translit: labōn oun to psōmion ekeinos exēlthen euthys. ēn de nyx.

paragraphs.text: When therefore he was gone out, Jesus saith, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him;
paragraphs.original: Ὅτε οὖν ἐξῆλθεν λέγει Ἰησοῦς· Νῦν ἐδοξάσθη ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐδοξάσθη ἐν αὐτῷ·
paragraphs.translit: Hote oun exēlthen legei Iēsous· Nyn edoxasthē ho hyios tou anthrōpou, kai ho theos edoxasthē en autō·

paragraphs.text: and God shall glorify him in himself, and straightway shall he glorify him.
paragraphs.original: εἰ ὁ θεὸς ἐδοξάσθη ἐν αὐτῷ, καὶ ὁ θεὸς δοξάσει αὐτὸν ἐν αὑτῷ, καὶ εὐθὺς δοξάσει αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: ei ho theos edoxasthē en autō, kai ho theos doxasei auton en hautō, kai euthys doxasei auton.

paragraphs.text: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say unto you.
paragraphs.original: τεκνία, ἔτι μικρὸν μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰμι· ζητήσετέ με, καὶ καθὼς εἶπον τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι Ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν, καὶ ὑμῖν λέγω ἄρτι.
paragraphs.translit: teknia, eti mikron methʼ hymōn eimi· zētēsete me, kai kathōs eipon tois Ioudaiois hoti Hopou egō hypagō hymeis ou dynasthe elthein, kai hymin legō arti.

paragraphs.text: A new commandment I give unto you, that ye love one another; even as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
paragraphs.original: ἐντολὴν καινὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους, καθὼς ἠγάπησα ὑμᾶς ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους.
paragraphs.translit: entolēn kainēn didōmi hymin hina agapate allēlous, kathōs ēgapēsa hymas hina kai hymeis agapate allēlous.

paragraphs.text: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
paragraphs.original: ἐν τούτῳ γνώσονται πάντες ὅτι ἐμοὶ μαθηταί ἐστε, ἐὰν ἀγάπην ἔχητε ἐν ἀλλήλοις.
paragraphs.translit: en toutō gnōsontai pantes hoti emoi mathētai este, ean agapēn echēte en allēlois.

paragraphs.text: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered, Whither I go, thou canst not follow now; but thou shalt follow afterwards.
paragraphs.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος· Κύριε, ποῦ ὑπάγεις; ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ὅπου ὑπάγω οὐ δύνασαί μοι νῦν ἀκολουθῆσαι, ἀκολουθήσεις δὲ ὕστερον.
paragraphs.translit: Legei autō Simōn Petros· Kyrie, pou hypageis; apekrithē Iēsous· Hopou hypagō ou dynasai moi nyn akolouthēsai, akolouthēseis de hysteron.

paragraphs.text: Peter saith unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee even now? I will lay down my life for thee.
paragraphs.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος· Κύριε, διὰ τί οὐ δύναμαί σοι ἀκολουθῆσαι ἄρτι; τὴν ψυχήν μου ὑπὲρ σοῦ θήσω.
paragraphs.translit: legei autō ho Petros· Kyrie, dia ti ou dynamai soi akolouthēsai arti; tēn psychēn mou hyper sou thēsō.

paragraphs.text: Jesus answereth, Wilt thou lay down thy life for me? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
paragraphs.original: ἀποκρίνεται Ἰησοῦς· Τὴν ψυχήν σου ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ θήσεις; ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, οὐ μὴ ἀλέκτωρ φωνήσῃ ἕως οὗ ἀρνήσῃ με τρίς.
paragraphs.translit: apokrinetai Iēsous· Tēn psychēn sou hyper emou thēseis; amēn amēn legō soi, ou mē alektōr phōnēsē heōs hou arnēsē me tris.
